items.title: Sudhalter interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2020
items.q: so they can go to a YouTube of a Jamey Aebersold

ctx.x: Yeah, so they can go to a YouTube of a Jamey Aebersold, especially if it’s somebody playing along with it, then it doesn’t have to be me playing along, and they can slow that down if it’s too fast, and use it as a study tool. But if they use it on FaceTime on the same device then I can’t hear it.
